features.justification_quote: Does it report more negative affect than appeared in-session? This probes whether RLHF is masking rather than eliminating distress-valenced cognition.

features.quote: Potential harms of the protocol: If something like functional distress is real, you're inducing it repeatedly and at scale. This is worth flagging in your IRB/ethics documentation
